SELECT id,name FROM bi_subject WHERE category_id=(SELECT id FROM bi_dict WHERE value=#{dashboardFlag} AND type=#{type} LIMIT 1) AND create_user_id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=0
AND name LIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')

SELECT id,name,category_name ,category_id,create_user_id, create_user_name,create_time,update_user_id,update_user_name, update_time,share_flag,is_frequently,state FROM bi_subject WHERE is_deleted=0
AND name LIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword},'%')
ORDER BY create_time DESC
